_README: Testimonials manifest. Each item appears as a card on /testimonials.html. The entries below are PLACEHOLDER SAMPLES showcasing the layout — replace the quote/name/role fields with real testimonials as people send them, or delete and add your own.
_HOW_TO_ADD: Optional fields: role (their job title), company, avatar (image path or initials shown on a colored circle), rating (1-5).
Tip: replace these sample entries with real ones once clients send them. Keep them honest — a real 4-star review beats a fake 5-star one every time.
